Meet our Red Panda pajama set — a four-layer cotton-gauze mommy-and-me favorite designed for cozy nights and lazy mornings. The button-front top with a notched collar and easy long pants in matching mom and daughter cuts make every moment match, from bedtime stories to brunch in pajamas. Soft, breathable, and built to be loved in, it's the kind of set families reach for again and again.

The print is pure storybook charm: watercolor red pandas curled around orchard peaches, leafy little sprigs, and gentle washes of orange and green on a warm ivory ground. The whole feel is sweet without being saccharine — equal parts garden, treehouse, and grandma's kitchen. Pull on the matching set for picture-perfect family photos, holiday cards, birthday mornings, weekend brunch, or just because matching is more fun.

Key Features:

  • Four-Layer Cotton Gauze: Breathable, soft, and a little weightier than single-layer cotton — perfect for mild-weather nights.
  • Matching Mom + Daughter Cuts: Coordinated proportions, picture-ready in every size.
  • Button-Front Top: Notched collar with smooth front buttons — easy on, easy off.
  • Long Pants, Covered Elastic Waist: All-night comfort with no dig-in.
  • Family Sizing: Sized from Child 2 Years through Mother XL.

Make every moment match — slip into the Red Panda set and let the cuddles begin.
